@pytest.mark.sphinx('html', testroot='ext-autodoc')
def test_private_members_selection(app):
    # bare :private-members: documents all private members
    options = {"members": None, "private-members": None}
    actual = do_autodoc(app, 'class', 'target.Class', options)

    assert '   .. py:attribute:: Class._private_inst_attr' not in list(actual)

def test_subplots_clear_keeps_shared_tick_configuration():
    """
    clear()ing Axes of a shared subplot grid must keep the tick configuration
    installed by the sharing machinery (hidden tick labels on inner subplots
    and one-sided tick marks) instead of resetting it to bare rcParams ticks.
    """

        ax.plot([0, 1], [0, 1])
    before = [(ax.xaxis._major_tick_kw.copy(), ax.yaxis._major_tick_kw.copy())
              for ax in axes.flat]
    for ax in axes.flat:
        ax.clear()
    for i, (ax, expected) in enumerate(zip(axes.flat, before)):
        for name, kw_before in zip("xy", expected):
            kw_after = getattr(ax, f"{name}axis")._major_tick_kw
            # gridOn legitimately resets on clear; nothing else may change.
            assert ({k: v for k, v in kw_after.items() if k != "gridOn"}
                    == {k: v for k, v in kw_before.items() if k != "gridOn"}), \\
                f"ax {i}: {name}-axis tick configuration changed by clear()"

## Root cause
The 3.4.2 regression has two independent parts, both fixed in production code:

1. **`Axes.cla()` did not re-apply rcParams-derived tick_params.** In 3.4.2, `Axes.__init__` replays `tick_params(top=..., bottom=..., ..., which='minor'/'major')` at the end of `__init__`, but since `cla()` is what `__init__` uses for setup, any user customization (e.g. `tick_params(top=False)` or rcParams `xtick.top: True`) was wiped by `Axis.clear()`'s `_reset_*_tick_kw()` + `reset_ticks()` on later `ax.clear()` calls — reintroducing top/right ticks.
2. **`SubplotBase._label_outer_xaxis/_label_outer_yaxis` effects were lost on `cla()`.** `Axis.clear()` → `reset_ticks()` re-creates Tick objects from `_major_tick_kw`, so the `labeltop/labelbottom/labelleft/labelright=False` applied by `label_outer()` at creation time vanished, un-hiding shared-axis tick labels.

def test_subplots_hide_ticklabels_after_clear():
    # clear() resets the Axis, but must not lose the ticklabel visibility
    # set up by the shared-axes layout of Figure.subplots (stored in
    # Axis._major_tick_kw), otherwise the ticklabels of the inner Axes are
    # unhidden and ticks reappear on the top/right sides.
    fig = plt.figure()
    axs = fig.subplots(3, 3, sharex=True, sharey=True)
    for ax in axs.flat:
        ax.clear()
    for (i, j), ax in np.ndenumerate(axs):
        # _major_tick_kw must still record the shared-axes layout so that
        # ticks created later keep hiding the ticklabels.
        assert ax.xaxis._major_tick_kw.get("label1On") == (i == 2)
        assert ax.xaxis._major_tick_kw.get("label2On") is False
        assert ax.yaxis._major_tick_kw.get("label1On") == (j == 0)
        assert ax.yaxis._major_tick_kw.get("label2On") is False
    fig.canvas.draw()
    for (i, j), ax in np.ndenumerate(axs):
        assert all(l.get_visible() == (i == 2)
                   for l in ax.get_xticklabels())
        assert all(l.get_visible() == (j == 0)
                   for l in ax.get_yticklabels())
        # ticks are only on the bottom/left sides by default
        for tick in ax.xaxis.get_major_ticks():
            assert not tick.tick2line.get_visible()
        for tick in ax.yaxis.get_major_ticks():
            assert not tick.tick2line.get_visible()


def test_hide_ticklabels_and_extra_ticks_after_clear():
    # Single-Axes variant: clear() must not re-enable ticks and ticklabels
    # on the sides for which the (default) rcParams turn them off.
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.clear()
    ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
    fig.canvas.draw()
    for tick in ax.xaxis.get_major_ticks():
        assert tick.tick1line.get_visible()      # xtick.bottom
        assert not tick.tick2line.get_visible()  # xtick.top
        assert tick.label1.get_visible()         # xtick.labelbottom
        assert not tick.label2.get_visible()     # xtick.labeltop
    for tick in ax.yaxis.get_major_ticks():
        assert tick.tick1line.get_visible()      # ytick.left
        assert not tick.tick2line.get_visible()  # ytick.right
        assert tick.label1.get_visible()         # ytick.labelleft
        assert not tick.label2.get_visible()     # ytick.labelright
